FROM dim_date

SELECT 
  dp.category,
  AVG(fsw.closing_value) AS average_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE ds.region = 'West'
  AND fsw.week_ending_date IN ('2025-03-02', '2025-03-09', '2025-03-16', '2025-03-23')
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY dp.category

calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ds.store_id) as west_stores
FROM dim_store ds
WHERE ds.region = 'West' AND ds.is_current = true

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as row_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ds.store_id) as distinct_stores,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dp.product_key) as distinct_products
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE ds.region = 'West'
  AND fsw.week_ending_date IN ('2025-03-02', '2025-03-09', '2025-03-16', '2025-03-23')

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_rows,
  COUNT(fsw.closing_value) as non_null_values,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fsw.closing_value IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as null_values
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE ds.region = 'West'
  AND fsw.week_ending_date IN ('2025-03-02', '2025-03-09', '2025-03-16', '2025-03-23')

SELECT 
  dp.category,
  ROUND(AVG(fsw.closing_value), 2) AS average_stock_value
FROM fact_stock_week fsw
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsw.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsw.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE ds.region = 'West'
  AND fsw.week_ending_date IN ('2025-03-02', '2025-03-09', '2025-03-16', '2025-03-23')
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY dp.category
